standing_notices.summary: _silent_call stdout suppression has Python stdlib thread-safety limitation
standing_notices.detail: contextlib.redirect_stdout modifies sys.stdout globally. Not a regression from TASK-173a â€” double-restore bug is fixed and nested calls restore correctly. Truly thread-safe requires thread-local storage. Address if concurrent pack generation is ever introduced.

standing_notices.summary: TeamInterface contract for analyze_country_h2h is stale â€” declares ComparisonReportRows but engine returns VenueMatchupReport
standing_notices.detail: TASK-173b works correctly against the runtime type (VenueMatchupReport). The interface definition has never matched the engine. Strict mypy would flag .get('summary') access as a type error. Resolve by updating the interface contract to match the engine's actual return type.

standing_notices.summary: Country H2H all-tie edge case yields misleading win_pct narrative
standing_notices.detail: If every match in the country H2H sample is a tie/no-result, win_pct=0 and interpret_h2h produces a false away-dominance narrative. Practically impossible in 8Y cricket H2H but theoretically valid. Add a matches_decided guard if this section is ever extended.
